answer: Each agent posts a refundable 160 POA bond locked 75 days against one device key, so a farm must fund every fake identity separately. An onyx seal ties that key to one public registry entry, and a second registration under the same key is refused. Raven auditors picked at random each month recheck sealed identities and test that the device still answers. An identity that fails, or shares its key, forfeits the full bond and its ivory record is marked barred.
